whatsNew: Mobile-first high-density redesign showing far more music above the fold, new Amber low-light Stage preset, WCAG 2.1 AA contrast & design token calibration, streamlined mobile Share & export sheet, and user-focused visual assets.
changes: Mobile-first Chart & Editor: slimmed the top/bottom bars, consolidated song metadata into a clean 2-line header (Artist · BPM + Capo + Details), kept a single sticky Key/Transpose stepper without duplicate chips, and tightened chart spacing so Verse 1, Chorus, and Bridge appear together on one screen.

High-density Songs library: streamlined phone rows into crisp 2-line entries (Key, Title, Pin, Artist, BPM, Capo, Star, Menu) with unclipped search and no bordered pill clutter, fitting up to 8 songs on a single phone screen.
2-column Bento Tools Hub: arranged all 8 harmony and practice tools in a compact 2-column mobile grid with live song context pills (chords, Key, Capo, BPM) and tucked Help cleanly into Settings.

Stage Amber low-light preset & compact header: added the #0c0a08 Amber stage theme alongside OLED Black, Dark, and Warm Paper, unlocked slim 34px mobile controls, and locked the stage title on one row beside Fullscreen and Exit.

Design system, Sharing & Asset polish: calibrated WCAG 2.1 AA light/dark contrast across all 5 accents, lazy-split Stage and Song Bank CSS to keep startup fast, compacted mobile Share/QR and 3-column Export controls with copy checkmarks, refined shared-song banners, added /play/drums link previews, unified user-focused branding, and consolidated release logs cleanly by day.

whatsNew: Resilient Google Drive sync with silent refresh, setlist tags & favorites, rich song status badges, clean pagination across every tab, sidebar pinned items, and native desktop hover/right-click context menus.
changes: Google Drive sync persistence & silent refresh: keeps your Drive session safely across reloads and app updates, silently refreshes expired access tokens in the background (`prompt: none`) before falling back to Reconnect, and limits reconnect prompts to at most once every 12 hours.

Setlist tags, favorites & sorting: keep the Sort dropdown visible across Setlists (default Latest to Oldest), add optional tags (Church, Worship, Gig, Performance, Rehearsal, Acoustic, or custom tags), favorite setlists (surfaced in Favorites too), and floating dropdown menus on per-slot Key/Capo selectors.
Rich row badges & pagination: All, Favorites, Setlists, and Song Bank show live status pills, relative update times, and clean 12-item pagination controls with one-tap Show all.
Desktop polish: sidebar Recent list with Pinned songs, artist/status subtitles, and full relative timestamps, plus desktop hover quick-actions and native right-click context menus.

whatsNew: Per-setlist Key & Capo overrides that leave your base song untouched, one-tap Auto-Format and Paste-to-Format recovery, ChordPro (.cho) exports, optional Mood/Tone tags, live setlist update alerts, complete Filipino translations, and 18 AI/MCP tools.
changes: Per-setlist Key & Capo overrides: override a song's Key or Capo per slot inside Edit setlist or Key & capo while playing a setlist—applied across Chart, Stage, and PDF/PNG/TXT/ChordPro exports without mutating the base song.

One-tap Auto-Format & blocked-site recovery: the Format button cleans raw chord pastes into ## Section headers, repairs chord typos (D/F#m → D/F#), strips voicing legends, collapses gaps, and wraps long lines; blocked imports offer a 1-tap Paste chart text -> Auto-Format fallback with source link preservation.

ChordPro (.cho) export & Mood/Tone tags: export single songs or setlists as standard .cho files alongside PDF, PNG, TXT, and Print; add optional searchable Mood/Tone tags beside Genre in Song details.

Broader chord extraction, live Drive setlist alerts & Filipino i18n parity: added Next.js __NEXT_DATA__ and HTML chord table parsing, 30s live setlist update notifications with 1-tap refresh, and full English/Filipino parity.

Tools Hub & AI/MCP v7.3+: 2-column tablet Tools Hub, Key Finder quick link and C4-centered piano on mobile, neutral slate section pills, modular lazy dialog sheets, and 18 annotated MCP tools with /llms-full.txt.

whatsNew: Chords-only mode across Chart, Stage, Import & Exports, Cmd/Ctrl+K Quick Song Switcher, sharper chord & IV-opening key detection, 1-tap Key/Capo overrides, multi-song PNG setlist exports with QR links, and streamlined Google Drive live setlists.
changes: Chords-only mode & import toggle: switch any chart in View, Stage, Import, or Exports (PDF/PNG/TXT/Print) to display pure chord progressions with compact spacing and tap-to-hear popups.

Chord & key detection fixes: accurately parses glued hyphens (Bm///-, G-D), slash-bass typos (D/F#m), section prefixes (Verse 1: G C), suspended/add2/add4 chords, IV-opening progressions, and concert Key + Capo metadata without double-shifting.
1-tap Key & Capo overrides everywhere: tap Key or Capo directly under song titles, use Capo −/+ steppers in Key & capo, set Capo in Song details, or adjust both Key and Capo inside Import preview.

Quick Song Switcher & mobile Share import: press Cmd/Ctrl+K (or tap Switch / Stage title) to jump across songs, unwrap mobile Share text + URL snippets automatically, and copy imported source links in one tap.

Clean margins, multi-page 9:16/16:9 PNG setlist exports & Drive live setlists: balanced chart margins, scannable QR codes on setlist PNGs, direct Drive sign-in in Share, 4s auto-sync, and rich /set/<id> link previews.

whatsNew: A calmer 3-tab layout (Songs, Chart, Tools) with a dedicated Tools Hub, a rearranged Minor Circle of Fifths and interactive Key Finder, floating popover dropdowns, a 30-day Trash for deleted songs and setlists, and built-in AI Agents & MCP connectivity.
changes: Songs · Chart · Tools: top and bottom navigation focus on three main spaces, while Chord Finder, Circle of Fifths, Key Finder, Piano, Fretboard, Tuner, Metronome and Drum Beats & Pads live in Tools Hub (/tools) with a ← All tools pill.

Minor Circle of Fifths & Key Finder (/tools/key-finder): switching to Minor places Minor keys on the outer ring (Am at 12 o'clock); pull active song chords in one tap to compare Major and Minor candidates and highlight them directly on the Circle.
Floating popover menus & 30-day Trash: dropdowns open as anchored floating menus with keyboard navigation; deleted songs and setlists move to 30-day Drive-synced Trash with Undo restore.
AI Agents & MCP: registers WebMCP tools (navigator.modelContext and window.sonataAgent) and provides a Remote MCP endpoint (/api/mcp) with Google Drive OAuth 2.1 + PKCE.

whatsNew: Calmer light and dark themes, auto-fitting charts that keep chords over words on any screen, 9:16 phone PNG exports, one-step Add to setlist, and hardware page-turner pedal support on stage.
changes: Calmer themes & ready-to-read phones: warm grey-and-white light mode, soft charcoal dark mode, full-row click to open charts directly in View on phones, and single-line artist/key/tempo metadata.
Auto-fitting chord lines & hold-to-ring Circle: chart text sizes automatically so chord lines stay unbroken above lyrics on phones and stage; press and hold Circle wedges or key chords to sustain.
Add to setlist & Page-Turner Pedals: add any song to a setlist from its menu in Songs; use Page Down/Up or pedals on stage to turn screens and advance seamlessly through setlists.

9:16 / 16:9 PNG previews, dismissible toasts & 320px ergonomics: high-resolution multi-page PNG previews matched to screen orientation, closeable backup reminders, and clean single-row Stage controls on narrow phones.

whatsNew: Floating YouTube reference player, guided tour & contextual Help, Backup & restore with earlier library snapshots, full offline instrument sounds with smaller starter downloads, live Google Drive setlists, and Privacy & terms.
changes: Floating YouTube player & bigger QR: YouTube song links play in a resizable mini/large overlay with 5-second skip and 0.75×/0.5× playback speed across screens; tapping any QR code zooms full-screen.

Guided tour, Help (?) & Backup & restore: interactive first-visit tour, contextual Help sheet (press ?), one-tap checksummed backup files, 15 automatic local restore snapshots, and persistent storage requests.

Live Google Drive setlist links: publish one Drive-hosted setlist link that stays up to date automatically while band members keep their personal key and capo, plus an Update my copy option for shared songs.

Offline instrument sounds & lighter startup: caches every piano, guitar, bass, and ukulele sample on first play or via Settings (3.8 MB), lazy-loads Play/Theory/Stage/Drive/Filipino translations, and removes legacy buddy/branding assumptions.
Privacy, reliability & Song Bank focus: plain-language Privacy & terms page (/privacy), single calm crash-recovery toast, faster automated bundle budget checks, and a focused Song Bank experience.

whatsNew: Import: paste a link to a chord page and Sonata fills in the chart for you.
changes: Import (was "Add from links"): paste a link to a chord page, the chords themselves, or Sonata links. Title, artist, key, capo, tempo and sections are filled in, with a preview before you add it.
Graceful paste fallback for protected chord sites and drag-and-drop support for .txt and ChordPro files.
Web Share Target support for installed PWAs and accurate detected key preview.

whatsNew: Desktop & tablet side-by-side song peek, cleaner multi-page PNG & PDF exports, and dedicated Drums tab with its own tempo control.
changes: Side-by-side library peek on tablets in landscape and desktop: tap a song to preview its chart, key, tempo, Edit, Present, and Share controls alongside the list.
Cleaner multi-page chart exports: crisp section rules, high-contrast chords on white paper even in dark mode, key/tempo tags, quiet timing marks, and automatic pagination.
Drums tab with independent tempo, horizontal-scroll edge fades on chip rows, and dark-mode Circle selection polish.

whatsNew: A new Chords tab, a Song Bank for requests, smaller QR codes that scan reliably, and setlists you can send as song links.
changes: Chords: look up any chord (including slash chords) with guitar, ukulele, bass and piano diagrams; tap any chord in a chart to view its shapes.
Theory and Play expansions: slash chords, walking bass lines, secondary dominants, extended voicings, and all chords of the active song.
Song Bank, setlist song links, YouTube links, half-size PDFs, phone-landscape & stage responsive improvements, and reliably scannable compact QR codes.

whatsNew: Safer multi-tab saving & Drive conflict handling, bug-fix hardening across deletion/tuner/modals, keyboard-navigable instrument tabs, one-tap setlist printing, and faster first load.
changes: Multi-tab & Google Drive safety: prevents browser tabs from overwriting each other, re-merges concurrent Drive writes, keeps deleted songs from returning across sync, and removes persistent disk OAuth tokens.
Stability & security hardening: fixed setlist delete confirmation, tuner double-start microphone cleanup, fallback in-memory mode when browser storage is blocked, and non-indexed personal routes.
Usability & performance: Arrow/Home/End keyboard navigation across Play tabs, Print button in setlist menus, lazy-loaded dialogs, and 60% smaller app icons.

whatsNew: A new, simpler Sonata: a calmer paper/charcoal design, streamlined navigation, sharps/flats in Key & capo, tappable song links, and fast offline-first loading.
changes: Calmer light paper and soft dark themes with Inter and JetBrains Mono typography and clearer stage readability.
Streamlined navigation, welcome starter choices, sharp/flat key rewriting via Write into chart, and tappable http(s) song links.
Single-bundle fast start, self-hosted fonts, offline update reload prompt, home-screen shortcuts, and strict CSP/share-link safety guards.

whatsNew: Full modular rebuild: light/dark/accent themes, unified navigation, Google Drive sync, per-song transpose & capo, interactive Circle of Fifths, sustaining instruments with slash chords & chord players, tuner, metronome, stage mode, PDF/PNG/QR exports, and offline PWA.
changes: Design & Navigation overhaul: cohesive light/dark/system themes, 5 accent colors, unified responsive navigation (desktop sidebar + mobile bars), compact phone editor with sticky toolbar, and interface text scaling.

Interactive Music Tools: redrawn Circle of Fifths with Auto-rotate and Lock key; Piano, Fretboard (Drop D, bass, ukulele), and Chord Players with real-time note sustain, orange bass notes on slash chords (G/B, D/F#), and chord naming.

Stage, Tuning & Sync: audio-clock metronome (2/4 to 12/8, tap tempo), precision mic tuner, screen-awake Stage mode with touch-pausing auto-scroll and 3 presets, setlist management, and seamless merging Google Drive sync.
Sharing & Foundation: self-contained share links, scannable QR cards, PDF exports with accented letters, 50-step transpose undo stack, and offline Workbox service worker.

whatsNew: Stage Mode responsive overhaul with in-stage transposition & setlist navigation, Circle F#/Gb precision, Roman slash bass degrees, and WCAG AA accessibility hardening.
changes: Re-engineered Stage Mode top bar and bottom dock for 320px–430px phones and landscape viewports, adding in-stage transpose steppers (♭/♯), Prev/Next setlist controls, notation switcher, and touch thumb-pause.
Fixed F♯/G♭ Circle key family resolution, persistent ♯/♭ preference, and unambiguous Roman numeral slash bass degrees (I/3, V/7, I/♭7).
Normalized dialog z-index layering, mobile split-editor switching, dark-mode WCAG AA contrast, Escape dismissal, and ARIA labels across tabs and instruments.

whatsNew: Google Drive sign-in origin & account safeguards, cleaner desktop Play & Circle spacing, quieter UI audio, and view isolation fixes.
changes: Google Drive Sync validates web origins before starting OAuth and shows clean account selection without duplicate popups.
Separated desktop Virtual Piano, full-width Fretboard, and Reference Tuner rows, balanced Circle size, and isolated active views.
Removed UI click sounds and added output limiting for gentle, non-clipped chord playback.

whatsNew: Desktop full-height split IDE, interactive syntax quick-start chips, metadata chips, live save indicator, unsaved changes guard, and mobile responsive navigation.
changes: Full-viewport desktop split editor + preview panes, syntax quick-start chips, metadata chips, and live Saved/Saving status dot.
Toast notification system, destructive action confirmations, unsaved changes protection, and 50-step transpose undo history.
Cross-platform Cmd/Ctrl+S keyboard shortcut hints, WCAG AA high-contrast focus rings, and floating Stage exit control.

whatsNew: Early AI Co-Writer prototype with BYOK settings, undoable actions, inline confirmations, and expanded About dialog.
changes: Added initial Co-Writer panel with BYOK API settings, undoable automated actions, inline clear confirmations, and upgraded UI feedback.

whatsNew: Direct compact share links, embedded QR codes in PNG & PDF exports, mobile Edit/Preview switcher, user profile greeting, and persistent view state.
changes: Direct ultra-shortened share links and scannable QR code generation inside PNG and PDF exports without third-party shorteners.
Mobile Edit/Preview/Split editor view switching, cross-refresh view persistence, and precise modification timestamps.
Personalized account greeting & cached avatar, manual key override for Piano/Fretboard, and universal PWA install support.

whatsNew: Cleaner responsive layout with offline Service Worker caching, optional Arranger auto-fill, and official Sonata navbar branding.
changes: Full offline Service Worker precaching for installed PWAs, cleaner whitespace across viewports, and optional Google account Arranger auto-fill.

whatsNew: English & Filipino localization and interactive Capo transposing.
changes: Multi-language localization support (English & Filipino), manual key overrides, and Guitar Capo transposing with preview labels.

whatsNew: Initial release of Sonata.
changes: Offline interactive chord chart editor, virtual piano, fretboard, chromatic tuner, Circle of Fifths, Nashville & Roman numerals, Google Drive sync, and QR sharing.
